scope: One variable-width synchronized pending-return DP candidate; no official global scoring
routing: Private homogeneous M/V+/M chains; equal intra-chain ordered descriptors and disjoint ascending compute-ID and tensor-ID blocks. No input filename or chain-count equality in algorithm.
algorithm: All capacity-feasible (r,q,s), q derived from footprints not swept constants; exact finite n,r shortest path; one compile per ordered prekey; all selected Tasks recompiled on original graph; pending returns and unequal remainders handled by explicit terminal suffix simulation.
terminal_policies: merge pending returns with intact remainder when capacity fits
postprocessing: Exact-rational verification of LP-proposed cycle-potential certificates on the recorded finite transition table; no new plans or parameter retuning.
unit_checks: Bounded algebraic/ordered-ID/state counterexamples only; no official performance claims.
failure_policy: Stop candidate on applicability, cache/signature, traffic or predicted/full-plan response disagreement; preserve all logs; do not tune and rerun on this input.
